notes: Real ICU patient records from PhysioNet Computing in Cardiology Challenge 2019 (Hospital Set A).
Downsampled from hourly measurements to realistic ward cadence (4.0–6h with jitter/gaps). Zero lookahead enforced.
Sensitivity (95% Wilson CI): WardPulse 74.5% [67.7%, 80.2%] vs NEWS2 73.9% [67.1%, 79.7%].
Median lead time (95% bootstrap CI): WardPulse 32.0h [26.0h, 43.0h] vs NEWS2 32.0h [25.5h, 46.0h].
Patient-level false alarm rate: WardPulse 64.6% (1173/1815) vs NEWS2 62.0% (1126/1815).
Workload: WardPulse 1.03 alerts/nurse-hr + 2.84 measurement tasks/nurse-hr vs NEWS2 1.04 alerts/nurse-hr.
